children: Torrid reported second quarter fiscal 2026 net sales of $231.7 million and net income of $5.2 million (basic and diluted EPS $0.05), driven in part by an $11.1 million tariff refund recorded in cost of goods sold. Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was $23.3 million (10.0% of net sales), or $12.1 million excluding the tariff refund benefit. The company raised full-year fiscal 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $76 million–$86 million to reflect the quarter’s tariff refund recognition while keeping other assumptions unchanged.
Net sales: $231.7 million for the three months ended August 1, 2026 (down 11.8% year‑over‑year vs. $262.8 million).
Gross profit: $89.7 million; gross profit margin 38.7% (33.9% excluding $11.1 million tariff refund benefit).
Operating income (income from operations): $14.5 million for the quarter.
Net income: $5.2 million, or $0.05 per share (basic and diluted).
Adjusted EBITDA: $23.3 million (10.0% of net sales); Adjusted EBITDA excluding tariff refunds: $12.1 million (5.2% of net sales).
Comparable sales declined 6.3% in the quarter, with sales trends improving as the quarter progressed and a notable inflection in July.
Merchandising adjustments implemented, including better balance of core and fashion assortments and strengthened footwear inventory, contributed to improving trends.
Customer growth initiatives gaining traction: expansion of sub-brands, lower opening price point strategy to drive conversion, and expansion into third-party marketplaces.

Marketing and engagement efforts intensified via personalized marketing, increased mobile app engagement, and a relaunched community program (Casting Call) to support acquisition, reactivation and retention.
Store footprint optimization: six store closures in the quarter, ending with 457 stores as part of a more productive store base strategy.
